pli-tv-bu-vb-np8:2.1.4: For an explanation of this, see comment at Bu NP 4:2.1.6.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np8:2.1.6: Agāraṁ is typically rendered as “in a house”. The problem with this is that it is not unallowable for a monastic to live in a building that is the equivalent of a house. What a monastic should not do is own a home and then live there.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np8:2.1.10: “Money” renders hirañña. See Appendix of Technical Terms for discussion.
